title: 第9章 大壮医生你快帮人家治治吧~~~
slug: 神医小傻驴的乡村女人
content_zh:
“没兴趣！”李大壮却一句话拒绝了张振生的提议。

    “大壮！！”

    李家二老异口同声的叫了一声，张桂芬更是急切的扯着李大壮的袖子，低声道：“你个傻小子，这多好的工作啊，听妈的，赶紧应下来！”

    “妈，你儿子已经不是以前的那个李大壮了，别说县医院了，就算是省立医院的工作，我也看不上眼！”

    “你！你这个混小子！咋还学会说大话了！？”张桂芬气的直瞪眼。

    “妈，我没说大话，刚才我给爸接手指的时候，你也看到了，我有这样的本事，何愁没前途？这种工作只会绑住我，让我无法施展！”

    “桂芬，大壮说的有道理，听大壮的！”

    李守义发了话，张桂芬虽然不甘心，却也只能生气的瞪了儿子一眼，就不再说话了。

    “行了，你的孝心，我心领了，看在你愿赌服输的份儿上，我也不难为你了，起来吧！”

    李大壮淡淡的看着林振生。

    “谢谢师父！”林振生擦了把汗，心里刚松了口气，就听见李大壮继续说：“哎！瞎叫啥呢？你想拜我为师，我可没答应！”

    “呃，您……”

    “我可不收你这么资质平庸的徒弟！”李大壮没好气的说。

    林振生傻眼了，合着自己虽然忍辱跪下了，却还是没结交上这位未来之龙？

    “那个，您不想收我也行，我能不能加您个联系方式，以后要是有个什么病痛，能找您去看吗？”林振生只能退而求其次。

    “行啊！不过我的诊费可不便宜！”

    “没问题，没问题，您本事大，诊费贵也是应该的！”林振生双手捧着手机，恭敬的加上了李大壮的微信。

    “帅哥，能不能加一下我的微信，我最近腰下面那个位置，总是不舒服，你帮我看看行吗~~”

    “还有我，我~我胸口闷，喘不上气来，你能给我扎几针吗？”

"What do you think?" Jiang Shuying twisted her waist and walked slowly towards Li Dazhuang, saying in a coquettish voice: "You know why you're asking~"

"Ruth went to work. There are still more than two hours until get off work. During this period, she won't come to see you. It's enough for us to have sex~"

While she was talking, Jiang Shuying had already arrived in front of Li Dazhuang. The two proud and snow-white figures were rubbing against Li Dazhuang's arms...

Soft!So soft!

Li Dazhuang looked down with rapid breathing, and the blood all over his body was boiling!

That piece of white flowers is like a big steamed bun just out of the pot, packed full and very tempting...

Li Dazhuang swallowed, and there was a battle between heaven and man in his mind!

Jiang Shuying felt Li Dazhuang's gradually rising body temperature and his surging male hormones up close, and her plump and lustrous body couldn't help but tremble!

"Da Zhuang, the manly scent on you smells so good, my sister-in-law likes it so much~"

"Give it to my sister-in-law, okay?"

Jiang Shu's legs were weak, his red lips were slightly open, and there was more and more spring water in his eyes. The ripples in the water seemed to be able to draw away people's souls...

"Sister-in-law, have you really thought about it?" Li Dazhuang's eyes were burning and his voice was hoarse!

Jiang Shuying nodded, her legs were too weak to hold up, her moist body could no longer hold up, and she fell directly into Li Dazhuang's arms. There was a real collision between softness and hardness, sparks flew, and the two people's breathing became entangled first, and became more and more rapid...

"Silly boy, don't hesitate. My sister-in-law has already thought about it. From the first time I saw you, my sister-in-law was moved. Later when you gave me a massage, I wished I could give myself to you on the spot~"

"Don't think that my sister-in-law is a frivolous woman. After my bastard man left, many brave men came to court me. No matter how hungry I was, they never let them touch a finger on me, and I didn't even give them a good look!"

"Sister-in-law only has feelings for you. I can't help but sweat when I see you~~"

"I want you to treat me hard~~"

As she spoke, Jiang Shuying's movements became more and more bold, and her whole body seemed to melt into Li Dazhuang's tall and strong body...

Li Dazhuang couldn't hold back anymore, so he directly pressed her on the sofa, buried his head and started to argue with her!

Jiang Shuying closed her eyes with a drunken expression, her whole body was trembling, she had finally waited for this moment!
